 The Rockets face their first true test of the season against the Spurs.
 by James Piercey Oct 24, 2026, 12:00 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Houston Rockets vs. San Antonio Spurs
 October 23, 2026
 Location: Moody Center, Austin, TX
 Time: 8:30 PM CST
 TV: Space City Home Network
 Radio :KBME Sports Talk 790 / KLTN 102.9 (en español)
 Probable Starters
 Rockets: Fred VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Jabari Smith Jr., Kevin Durant, Alperen Sengun
 Spurs: Dylan Harper, Stephon Castle, Devin Vassell, Julian Champagnie, Victor Wembanyama
